sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Looking at the image after moving LEFT 5 times:
- The black shape is now near the vertical divider
- The yellow L shape is fully visible (not covered by the black shape)
- The dots are all white now (none overlap the yellow L)
- The gray F is on the left side
This confirms that the dots change color based on overlap with the yellow L. When the black shape doesn't overlap the yellow L, all dots are white.
Now I can see the yellow L shape clearly:
- Top horizontal bar
- Left vertical bar
It's an L-shape with the corner at the top-left.
The dot pattern on the black shape is:
- Top row: 3 dots
- Right vertical column: 2 dots
This is also an L-shape, but with the corner at the top-right (mirrored).
So the goal might be to position the black shape so that the dot L pattern matches the yellow L pattern. Since they're mirrored, this might require rotating or flipping the black shape.
But wait, I don't see any rotation actions. The only actions are UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, SPACE, MOUSE, and ACTION7.
Let me think about this differently. Maybe ACTION7 does something more than just moving the shape. Let me check what ACTION7 does when the black shape is in a different position.
Actually, let me re-examine the history. I noticed that ACTION7 moves the black shape right by 3 columns, same as RIGHT. But maybe ACTION7 does something different when the black shape is in a specific position or when certain conditions are met.
Let me try pressing ACTION7 when the black shape is near the divider (current position) to see what happens.
